committees.name: Member's initiative
committees.description: As a member you also have the possibility of organising events without a committee. That is via the members initiative. committees.name: 4FunCie
committees.description: 4Funcie is responsible for organizing physical activities and outings outside of the usual gaming environment. Their events range from activities such as bowling and pooling to larger outings, such as a trip to the Efteling. The committee offers a great way to get active, try something new, and spend time together outside of gaming.

committees.name: LegaCie
committees.description: Legacie organizes a wide range of casual and social events for the Blueshell community. Their activities include regular gamenights as well as smaller social events such as potlucks, casino nights, and other fun activities where members can come together and meet new people.

committees.name: MCie
committees.description: MCie is the committee responsible for organizing Minecraft-related events within Blueshell. From creative competitions like the Building Game during the Kick-Off to modded server releases, Lucky Block Walls, Bingo, and more, MCie brings a variety of Minecraft activities to the community.

committees.name: NintenCo
committees.description: Welcome to the Nintenco committee! We are all big Nintendo fans and we work together to plan all kinds of event based around nintendo for blueshell! We always plan the yearly mario kart tournament and the Nintenco Pubquiz, but we also organize new Nintendo events each year.

committees.name: PRCie
committees.description: PrCie makes anything promotion related. A new banner, hoodies, or posters? Anything is possible in PrCie. We meet once per month to update each other on the projects, while we work on smaller projects in a group or solo. Newby or no idea how to design? Or a veteran in photoshop? Anyone is welcome in PrCie!

committees.name: DegeneraCie
committees.description: DegeneraCie is the committee for everything a little more niche. They organize VGMQs (Video Game Music Quizzes), anime-themed events, and other activities for members with an appreciation for gaming, anime, and all things wonderfully degenerate.

committees.name: KickCie
committees.description: KickCie is the committee responsible for everything related to the Kick-In. They help set up and prepare the Blueshell presence during the event, welcome and approach new members, and assist with activities throughout the Kick-In. The committee plays an important role in introducing new students to Blueshell and making sure they feel welcome from the start.

committees.name: CircuitCie
committees.description:
CircuitCie organises a yearly in-house tounament called Circuit Showdown that lasts for a longer period during the academic year. We host Esports matches of our four most popular Esports titles:
- Rocket League
- Valorant
- League of Legends
- Counter Strike 2
And sometimes other games too :D
These matches are played between 3-4 factions created at the start of the Circuit Showdown period.

committees.name: LanCie
committees.description:
LanCie is responsible for organizing LAN parties on behalf of Blueshell Esports. Our work ranges from small, internal gatherings to larger collaborative events with other gaming associations. We handle everything from venue scouting and logistics to coordinating with sponsors and other committees to make sure every LAN runs smoothly.
Whether you're into competitive tournaments or just want to game with friends in person, LanCie creates the space for that to happen. If you're interested in event planning, logistics, or simply want to help bring people together for some offline gaming, LanCie is the place for you.

committees.name: YapCie
committees.description: This is the committee for all streamers - rookie and veteran. It is a light workload, depending on whether you want to cast/stream a certain match yourself, observe, edit/manage the stream pack (the layout of the screen while streams are going on), or sit it out and just watch the magic happen. We have meetings approximately once a month, where we discuss what our future plans are (who wants to stream/observe, how are we going to spread the streams throughout the upcoming month, does the stream pack need updates, are there any games we want to cast, etc). Whether you want to show off your solo games or cast Blueshell's most entertaining home matches, YapCie is THE committee for you!

events.title: Deep Rock Galactic: New Season!
events.description:
Good day Miners,
HQ got a new mission for you. New discoveries on Hoxxes require your urgent attention. 
You’re delving into a brand new planetary region, pursuing new riches, and facing off those who might stand in the Company’s way.

 The Company has detected a new material that was recently unearthed by a series of planetwide tectonic shifts. Huge deposits of Resinite have been discovered all over Hoxxes.
Delve underground, seek out the Resinite Masses, dig them free, and extract them via the lift rockets we send down to assist in the endeavor. We’ve got no equipment to triangulate the exact location of Resinite Masses, so keep your eyes peeled for great amber chunks sticking out of the ground.

Next to that a new planetary region has been discovered, and management has approved the Ossuary Depths for extraction operations. This gloomy new biome is home to a grim collection of skeletal remains gathered from all over Hoxxes. And among these dusty bones lives a new threat: The Ossirans.

These bugs come in two variants hostile towards you dwarves. The first is a winged menace is capable of swarming you from above and below. It’s an agile threat when flying through the air, and its thick outer shell allows it to put up a strong defense when grounded. The second a larger variant of Ossiran lies in wait just below the surface, ready to ambush any dwarf that wanders too close. Its jaws are strong enough to incapacitate, and it’ll take a good chunk out of your health if it catches you.

Join us on March 2nd 19:00 at the predator Esports Lounge (or online) Miners when we venture unto these unknown caverns and gather the Resinite masses!

events.title: Half Year GMM
events.description:
Dear Member

As the half year approaches, we will also need to reflect on what has happened and want to present you with our plans for the coming half year. Thus the Half Year General Member Meeting will be hosted on the **13th of March at 19.00 at Spiegel 03** (Drienerlolaan 5, 7522 NB )

**What is a GMM?**
The GMM is a general meeting of an association in which all members are invited. Each member has a right to vote on important topics which could influence the future of the association. In general, members are able to discuss (enacted and upcoming) policy plans or raise important questions and issues with regards to the association.

Please check the email you should have received. Attached to it is a drive folder which you should be able to access. In this folder the following documents are shared:  Change GMM Minutes 2025-2026; HGMM Agenda 2025-2026; Half Year Report 2025-2026; Half Year Budget Report 2025-2026; Blueshell Esports - Statuten changes 2026 (Dutch Only). If you did not receive this email, or cannot access the drive, please refer to #board-questions

Should you have any inquiries or comments regarding the contents of the documents, kindly direct your correspondence to secretary@blueshell.utwente.nl.

Should you not be able to attend but still want to participate in the discussions, don't forget that you can authorize another member to represent you. Inform the board beforehand via email or Discord, stating who you want to represent you. Each member can hold a maximum of 2 authorizations. Emails can be sent to board@blueshell.utwente.nl.

As per Article 11a of the Blueshell House Rules, motions must be submitted in writing and signed by at least 5 members before the GMM.

We look forward to your attendance and active participation in this important meeting! Your input and engagement are invaluable to our association's future.

Kind regards,
Board 9

Japan is more than just anime intros and Vtubers, so we host an Origami workshop to introduce the other aspects of Japanese culture and society. This workshop is given by Kazuya, a friend of one of our members, who is a Japanese ex-Vtuber director. He came to the Netherlands and opened a Japanese food and craft shop in Enschede. Here he explains his life story: https://www.tiktok.com/@aya.enschede/video/7649828224343641365

During the event, he will teach you the art and craftmanship of folding paper into complex shapes and why it has been deeply ingrained in Japanese culture. Folding paper is a simple task, but creating animals and objects from just a single sheet of paper is an art form in itself. You can join this event for free! Kazuya's shop offers more workshops, like making Onigiri, Sushi and grinding your own matcha. You can also get Japanese snacks like karaage, ebi tempura and donburi. Check out their store on the Hengelosestraat! Their website is: https://www.ayaorigamitea.nl/

events.title: GMM
events.description:
Dear Member of Blueshell

As the new year started, we will need to change the board, and welcome a new lead by Board 10. To do this, every year the Change General Member Meeting is organized. This will be on the 15th of September at 19:00 in SP04  (Drienerlolaan 5, 7522 NB )

What is a GMM?
The GMM is a general meeting of an association in which all members are invited. Each member has a right to vote on important topics which could influence the future of the association. In general, members are able to discuss (enacted and upcoming) policy plans or raise important questions and issues with regards to the association.

Please check the email you should have received. Attached to it is a drive folder which you should be able to access. In this folder the following documents are shared:  hGMM minutes - 13/03/2026, Change GMM Agenda - 16/09/2026, Year Report 2026-2027, Budget Report 2026-2027, Policy Plan 2026-2027 and Budget Proposal 2026-2027. If you did not receive this email, or cannot access the drive, please refer to ⁠board-questions 

Should you have any inquiries or comments regarding the contents of the documents, kindly direct your correspondence to secretary@blueshell.utwente.nl.

Should you not be able to attend but still want to participate in the discussions, don't forget that you can authorize another member to represent you. Inform the board beforehand via email or Discord, stating who you want to represent you. Each member can hold a maximum of 2 authorizations. Emails can be sent to board@blueshell.utwente.nl.

As per Article 11a of the Blueshell House Rules, motions must be submitted in writing and signed by at least 5 members before the GMM.

We look forward to your attendance and active participation in this important meeting! Your input and engagement are invaluable to our association's future.

Kind regards,
Board 9 and Candidate Board 10

events.title: Ye Olde Quest for the Eleven Ales
events.description:
Hear ye, hear ye

On this eighteenth day of September, ye are most cordially invited to leave thy hearths and ride forth alongside thy fellow members, in a most splendid chance to strengthen the bonds of our noble Association.

A Quest awaits thee: a journey betwixt eleven abodes belonging to some of the finest souls Blueshell hath to offer. At each stop, fair ales and sundry libations shall be enjoyed; and for the young, the infirm, and those who favour a clearer head, draughts free of spirits shall likewise be provided. A map of our route hath been prepared, lest any brave rider lose their way.

Our company shall travel by means of the trusty two-wheeled pedal machine. Should thou lack such a steed, summon The Old Man (on discord), that suitable arrangements may be made and thy place upon this Quest secured.

Along the way, ye shall undertake a challenge designed to bring thee closer to thy companions. Whosoever completes their full list of tasks before the Quest’s end shall be rewarded accordingly.

Once the official programme hath concluded, our merry band shall find itself in the heart of fair Enschede, where the revelry shall continue well into the evening.

With kindest regards,
The Old Man  and the esteemed members of @TourCie
